For Nairobi businesses

List your business

No listing fee. You pay a commission only on customers we send you. Customers contact you directly on WhatsApp or by phone and pay you directly.

1. Send your details

Fill in the form. It opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send to us.

2. We check and set up

We confirm your details and ask for 3–5 photos.

3. You go live

Your listing appears with WhatsApp, Call and Directions buttons.
